lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: It’s been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been, Einst?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: There was no big deal. By the way, I heard about your activities in Eastland.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: He saves a kingdom in trouble, meets the girl he has been looking for, and helps her become a true goddess... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It just so happened that it happened like that.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Clearly you've had a lot going on. Still, I hope you don’t lose your composure.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: There's a saying in Freios, friend. ‘If you think about it too complicatedly, nothing will happen.’

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll remember those words. But what did you call me for?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I was already going to tell you that story.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Have you ever heard of Magic Academy Zelenis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I've heard of it, but I'm not sure exactly. A school to learn magic, that's all.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: This arrived in your name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: (Einst takes out a letter from his pocket and hands it to %s.)

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: This is an invitation to the school festival sent from Zerenis Academy. I checked and the recipient was you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did I receive an invitation to the school festival... .

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I think they probably thought you were a special person and invited you to the school festival. They don't send invitations to anyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: What happened in the meantime? Let's start with suspicion. The seal on the letter is from Zerenis Magic Academy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I needed more information.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I see. If that's the case, Jade from Infinite Corridor will tell you more than me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. I heard that Jade graduated from a magic academy. I'll go and ask.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: I was invited to go there before, and the school festival was more fun than I thought. You look a little tired, I hope you find some time to relax.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you.

lines.speaker: 아인스트
lines.text: Oh, and when you come here later after the school festival, I'll tell you a good story. If you're interested, come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. See you later then.

steps.name: The road to Zelenis Hill
steps.objective: Go to [Shiina] in the “Magic Academy Lobby”.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It’s been a while, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Jade. I came here because I wanted to get help.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Looking at the letter you are holding in your hand, it seems that it is already school festival season.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, you recognize me as expected.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Because the letter has the seal of my alma mater attached to it. I don't think you've opened it yet. Would you like to try it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Open the invitation and check the contents inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 「Adventurer, God’s messenger! You are invited to the school festival ‘Daphne’ at Magic Academy Zerenis.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “Magic Academy Zerenis Student Council.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It says. By the way, there is no sign leading to Zelenis Magic Academy? How do I get there?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Ah… . Since you are from somewhere else, you may not know where Zerenis Magic Academy is.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It seems like the student council has committed a discourtesy. I will apologize on your behalf.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's okay. It could be so.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I guess it was because the juniors thought the school was a very famous place. Then I'll tell you where to go.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Zerenis Magic Academy is located on Zerenis Hill, heading northwest from the western part of the El Anor Plains.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: There is also a building at the steepest end of the hill. The first emperor of the empire established it, saying, ‘A school is a hill, after all.’

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You can't go there from the southern region where the guild union is currently located. As kobolds increasingly attacked travelers and stole their belongings, the passage was closed... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So how can I get there?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: We created a portal inside the void so that we could get there safely. You can go to Zerenis Hill through there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected... , The wizards of the Infinite Corridor are amazing.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: What? We just want our magic to be useful to everyone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jade, thank you. By the way, isn’t Jade going to this school festival?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I didn't get an invitation... .

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: (Jade shows a sullen expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … cheer up.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It's okay. The invitation criteria for school festivals are different every time, so you can't go to everyone you want.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Ha, but I was invited two years ago and had a great time... .

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Come to think of it, I heard that Your Majesty wasn't invited this time either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, I really don't know the standards if even His Majesty the Sylvaria Empire can't come.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: So, hehe. If you go, we hope you enjoy the school festival at our alma mater.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Oh, if you have time, I hope you'll come visit us later. It's not busy, so you can come slowly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Thank you, Jade.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then, shall we go to Zelenis Hill...?)

steps.name: Discontinued school festival (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Maestro Department 1st Year Student] and [Smug Spirit of Knowledge] at "Zerenis Hill" and report to [Soreille] in the "Magic Academy Lobby".

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Senior!! We evacuated the children, teachers, and invited guests from the main building.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I also evacuated some of the people in the training center.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I can't do anything about the children affected by the curse. I can't solve it on my own... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina, I couldn’t help it either. Shall we take a breather and find a way out?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, senior. Ah, I don't know if I should say this in this situation... . Just relax... Can you please call me that?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Wow, that's not possible. How can I comfortably call this noble name?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Then there is nothing we can do. Even if I tell my sister... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Huh, don’t do that!! I will call you by your name, so please do that!!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: My name is Shiina, Senpai! Please take care of me.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Okay, Shiina... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Thank you for calling me. It would be nice if you could speak comfortably.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Let's start with the name.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, senior!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I'll take a look around the school again. I think there are people who haven't evacuated yet... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina, please stay here and if there are any guests who came for the school festival, please send them away.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, in the meantime, I will continue to look for a way to break this curse.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: (Shiina unfolds her notes and understands the situation.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: This isn't a joke that happens every school festival season. It seems like someone intentionally placed a curse... , Who on earth…

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… . hey.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: There would be no reason to do something like this in the Tower of the Wise... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you there? Student, can you hear me?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Wow, what a surprise! Who are you... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn’t this Magic Academy Zelenis? I came because I heard there was a school festival... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Welcome to Magic Academy Zelenis School Festival ‘Daphne’! Huh, the comment came out automatically without me even realizing it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness. I thought it was late, but it came just in time!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, welcome! But what? Phew… . Due to circumstances, I will not be able to participate in this school festival.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came this far because you sent me an invitation. Is this really not possible? Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: (Shiina is slightly surprised when she sees the invitation from %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Eh, why are you surprised?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. I thought about something else for a moment. God's errand boy... You are %s, the hero who saved the kingdom of Jude in Eastland, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: So could you please do me a favor for a moment? It's a bit urgent... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. If it's not difficult, you can do it.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: You may have seen a lot of strange situations on your way to Zelenis Hill. First of all, could you please stop strange students and rampaging objects from going outside?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I'll tell you more details later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Then I'll come right away.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer!

steps.name: Discontinued school festival (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Maestro Department 2nd year student] and [1st year magic broom] at "Zerenis Hill" and report to [Shiina] in the "Magic Academy Lobby".

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Oh, that person… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Student, I solved it. Huh, Soreyu? Why is Soreyu here? .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It’s been a while, %s. I see you have an invitation, so I guess you came to the school festival.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: But if you are a student... . Are you talking about the girl with the long ponytail and the red ribbon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. The student asked us to prevent the strange objects that appeared on Zerenis Hill from escaping out into thin air.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, where did the student go?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina, no, it's Shiina, she said she wanted to bring something from the student council room and went in for a moment.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It's okay because it's a space with a barrier, but what about other places... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: First of all, I'm trying to stop it somehow, but it won't be easy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on? There were a lot of strange magic tools on the hill... .  I originally thought it was like this because it was near a magic academy, but that wasn't the case.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Ah, I guess Shiina hasn't told me yet. then… I can’t tell you either.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Still, I've come this far, I can't just go back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could it be that this is also an abnormal phenomenon caused by Iris?)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Sorry, but can I ask you to do the same thing just once? Please don't let strange objects escape into thin air.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So does that tell you what happened?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I promise you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all, I will come back one more time as requested.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina will be there by the time you get back, so I'll tell you about it.

steps.name: A cursed school
steps.objective: Defeat [Zephyros] in the “Magic Training Center” and report to [Shiina] in the “Magic Academy Lobby.”

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Senior, that person is definitely exactly what you said.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I guess you taught Shiina a lot.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: What my sister saw and felt is not everything in this world, but she knows it to some extent.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Not only did you recognize Degoth and save me, but you continue to fight against those who threaten the world.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Ah, there you are. Now I have no choice but to tell you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Student, are you here? At Soreyu's request, I cleaned up the hill once again.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Thank you. Adventurer. Let me formally introduce myself. My name is Shiina, and I am a second-year student at Magic Academy Zerenis and the student council president.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shiina, Shiina. That's a pretty name.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Then, I will tell %s why Zerenis Hill and the school are like this.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Along with Zerenis Magic Academy, there is a place called ‘Sage’s Tower’, which is recognized for its own magic education authority.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: In some regions, the Temple of Ceres is also called the Tower of the Wise, but this is completely unofficial. You can think of it as convenience because so many people gather there.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The real ‘Wise Man’s Tower’ is located deep inside the continent, on a remote island further north.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see. I don’t know much about the Continent of Freios. Then, could you continue the story?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, I will tell you.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: While the magic academy is more popular, the Tower of the Wise studies magic itself. The density is slightly higher.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: By competing and cooperating with each other, we raised Freios' magic to a significant level.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: So, since we were close, we used to play pranks on the main base during our school festival or their large-scale magic seminars.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of joke is this?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I let Cerberus, who I brought from my hometown, play as much as he wanted in the front yard of the Tower of the Wise. That kid especially liked Jade... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: You are a senior whose story has become a legend. I heard that because of that, the people at the Tower of Wise Men couldn't even go outside for a week.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: At the Tower of the Wise, we also played pranks on our school festivals by making magic tools move randomly for a brief moment.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: However, this school festival is not like that. To call it a joke is closer to a curse... . I opened a gift box someone sent me, and a strange energy emanated from it.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The magic tools in the school moved randomly, and some students were affected by the curse and began destroying the school interior.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: So I asked Adventurer to take care of the strange objects on the hill. I thought that if I got out of the hill, I would be able to go everywhere through the open sea... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina first found a way to use the magical power flowing through this land, and together we opened a barrier. I was fortunate to have some magical gems at school.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: However, it won't last long. Because the power of the curse is greater, there is a limit to the magic power of the gems.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Additionally, this curse affects people with strong magical powers more. Although others evacuated, the board chairman, Mr. Zephyros and Principal Chloris... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: So, I needed to check Adventurer. I wonder if he is a special being who is not affected by this curse... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: My senior and I were lucky enough to have that qualification, but all we had to do was use magic to create a barrier to the school.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer happened to be here at that time. An errand boy who follows God and has special powers... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Come to think of it, Malphas said that the composition of the power I have is different from that of ordinary humans.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It seems like the power of the curse is now focused on the chairman and principal, who have powerful magical powers.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I think you two probably chose the best way to protect your students... . Now it has merged with certain objects and taken on a different form.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh… . Something like that... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The good news is that if we disperse their magical power, they, other students, and general objects will return to their original state.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I disperse their magic?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The special power of Adventurer will naturally disperse the bad power belonging to the two of you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Still, I don’t think it will be easy… . I'll worry about it later. The first thing to do is to resolve this situation.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Thank you. And I'm sorry. First, I will ask for Teacher Zephyros at the Magic Training Center.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll come back.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer! Teacher Zephyrus has returned to normal!! Thank you!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, that's a relief. But what kind of person is it that has such powerful magical powers?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Teacher Zephyrus is an agent of the Imperial Magic Agency. Known as the owner of powerful wind magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are a great person.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The Magic Agency dispatches special agents to each agency to keep conflicts caused by magic in check... , Teacher Zephyros came in that role.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: That's the role the chairman of the board originally had. Maybe that's why there seems to be some friction with the principal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's left now is the main building of the magic academy? There you are, Chloris.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina, you’re in big trouble!!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Senior, what's going on?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: All the energy from the training center rushed to the school!! Now, wait a minute. What on earth is this?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Huh, what should I do... ? If this happens, I can't go to school... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Soreyu... . I think this feeling is similar to that time. Like when I met Degos... , This curse could not be... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, %s… . that's right. It's the energy of the demon world. Why is the demonic energy hanging over the school?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Seo, senior. Is there any better way?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: There is a way... . Adventurer!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes. Soreille. Please tell me how.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Could you please go to Jade and borrow the gems used to create the Imperial Gate?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: With that, you can purify or erase traces of the demon world.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Adventurer, I have a favor to ask. Shiina and I will do our best to keep the energy of the demon world from escaping from this hill.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes! I'll be right back. Please be careful… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer, be careful too!!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina, let's take a look at the hill first. Don't let anything else happen... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, senior!! Oh, I… , I have a question. No, there's something I don't understand.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Why did the energy of the demon world appear here? I haven't heard of any demons appearing on Zerenis Hill for hundreds of years.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: … This is a secret, and I will only tell it to Shiina.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Our school has one of the relics of the gods. It's Windy Seed. Someone is shaking it right now.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Ah, so Teacher Chloris' magic was resonating with an unknown power. I didn't know that was the power of the artifact.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Senior, I’m sure you’ll be okay, right?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It'll be okay. So don’t worry too much, Shiina. Trust Adventurer.

steps.name: important tool
steps.objective: Go to [Soreyu] in the “Magic Academy Lobby”.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Uh, weren't you going to the school festival?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's because something happened suddenly. So I hurriedly came to see Jade.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Jade what happened at the magic academy.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I can't believe something like that happens... , I will look for it right away. Once you dismantle the parts, you can immediately use the gems you need.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Where did this go? There is definitely one left... .

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: Jade? Are you looking for Imperial Gate parts?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Do you know where it is?

lines.speaker: 마법사
lines.text: I left it at Archicity for repairs, and now a messenger has brought it to me.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Phew, that's a relief. Soreille knows how to dismantle it, so you can give it to Adventurer right away.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I want to go and help because it's my alma mater's job, but I have work to do... . sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Thank you for your help. I will go straight to Zelenis Academy.

steps.name: The end of the school festival
steps.objective: Defeat [Chloris] in the “Magic Academy Main Building” and report to [Shiina] in the “Magic Academy Lobby.”

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Give the jewel that is part of the Imperial Gate to Soreyu.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: This is the part... . When Jade said she was building the Imperial Gate, everyone was skeptical.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Still, he did it. Ah, I suddenly remembered the old days.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Senior, I think this will dispel the demonic energy to some extent.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, I will dismantle the parts right away.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: (The energy flowing from Soreyu's hand begins to disintegrate the parts. Then, a magical gem with a noble light appears inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It is a brilliant and beautiful jewel.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer, you can now enter the main school building.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, if we defeat Teacher Chloris, things will go back to normal, right?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: That said, you need to be more careful because the fusion is different from Zephyrus-sama.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: As I told Shiina, we have one of the gods' relics at our school. Just like it was stored in the Belfar Library.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It is ‘Windy Seed’.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It is an artifact, a relic of the ancient gods that helps breathe life into the earth. It flies like the wind and makes the earth sprout.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I don't know exactly what it does, but... , It has strong magical power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, if it’s Windy Seed… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think I've heard it before...)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Teacher Cloris will be there to make sure the students are not in danger.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: In addition to the energy of the demon world, a strange power filled this place. Adventurer, can you feel it too?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It's because Teacher Cloris's power and Windy Seed's power are meeting and resonating with each other. It may be that Windseed is causing the teacher's magic to run away... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This… . It's Chloris's power.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The ‘genius wizard Chloris’ recognized by the Empress. You came to school because you had work at the Magic Agency. Oh, that's not important now.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: No one knows what will happen if this situation continues.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer, I would like to ask you again. We need Adventurer's power now.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina and I will be working on erasing the energy of the Demon World, so I'll ask you to help us, Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay. Now, wait… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (An unknown ominous feeling passes through my entire body.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m afraid….)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Adventurer, why are you doing that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. It was because of my mood.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...This ominous feeling is similar to the feeling I had with the man I met at Lapier, the Tree of God...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. I'll go straight to Chloris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (%s's steps toward the main building of the magic academy become faster.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Adventurer, do you know something…? . Hey, Shiina… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, senior. Please speak.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Did Shiina's older sister even know that something like this would happen to Adventurer? That's why you asked for an invitation... .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Hmm… . I'm not sure about that. Because I can’t know everything about my sister.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Now, my senior and I have to protect the school. %s will do as %s does... . Senior, although my skills are lacking, I will ask you to please take good care of me.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Wow, it’s ridiculous to say that Shiina’s skills are lacking! anyway! Should I focus now and get the work done?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, senior!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Senior!! Senior!! Adventurer is here!!

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Really? Ah, Adventurer!! Adventurer!! Are you okay?
(Shiina and Soreyu approach with worried eyes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Thank goodness. It seems that the children who were negatively influenced and the school are returning to normal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rather, are you okay, Chloris? I was surprised that it disappeared right away.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Teacher Cloris, are you okay? Windy Seed, which was fused with the teacher, also returned safely to its original place.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Although he returned to his original form and was in good shape, he still felt it was necessary to check his physical condition, so he left for the Imperial Capital with Teacher Zephyros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute… , you already prepared? It hasn't been long since you returned to your original form.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: No, Adventurer. Two days have passed since Chloris came out and the school returned to its original state.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Since Adventurer did not appear, my senior and I kept looking, but Adventurer was nowhere to be seen.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Teacher Cloris said that Adventurer would be okay, but... , thank goodness. I'm so glad. I was very worried.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I came out to look around the school to check its status, but two days have passed... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: My guess is that the energy of the demon world was trying to transfer to Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I can't know for sure. This is possible if Windy Seed, who escaped from Teacher Chloris, protected Adventurer from the energy of the demon world.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: In the meantime, Adventurer may not have been aware of Windy Seed's protection.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I think about it… It didn't feel difficult at all. I felt like I was going to die when I fought Chloris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this Windy Seed’s ability…?)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Adventurer, thank you again. I think we need to prepare thoroughly to prevent something like this from happening next time.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Could it be that we were too conceited? Who would have thought that the magic academy would be defenseless due to something like this... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Shiina, I will find a way, so don’t worry too much.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, senior!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Shiina, Soreyu. I think it's finished now, so I'll go. I need to get some rest.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Are you going already?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone from a place called Tartarus told me to rest. But what else would he do if he found out I wasn't there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So, I'm going to just explain the school situation to Jade and then head over there.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I see. I don't know when, but I will treat you to a delicious dessert from the Hmong Monggeul Guild.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: And if you have time, could you come back here later? I have something else to say. I'll be here for a while, so you can come when it's convenient for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Hey, Adventurer… . I will send you an invitation to the school festival later, so can you come by one more time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. If you invite me, I will definitely come. Of course, you have to prevent this kind of commotion from happening.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Hehe, that won't happen next time. Then please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, see you next time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I hope the ominous feeling I felt here is just my mood… As soon as I have time, I need to meet the Iris body I am training in as soon as possible.)

steps.name: Message from the Empress?
steps.objective: Go to [Rena Hiren] at the “Silver Shield Tavern”.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: You're back. Thank you for your effort sorry. I should have helped too... . Something happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. It was okay because besides me, there were also Shiina and Soreyu. It was also possible because of Jade's help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He then defeats Chloris and says that he was in a space unaffected by time for a while due to the influence of the relic Windy Seed.)

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: … Yes?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: I had a rough guess that the school had ancient artifacts, but it's surprising that they have such abilities.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: There is one thing I am worried about. The fact that the energy of the Demon World appeared in the school where the relic is located reminds me of the past.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you talking about the painter's job?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Yes, that's right. The Degos defeated by Adventurer attempted to use two ancient artifacts. In order to connect the demon world and this world... .

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: There is a little hole, and the energy of the demonic world is coming in through the gap. Still, many powers, including the empire, guild unions, and religious denominations, are steadily searching for and filling the space.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a relief.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: It's a little frustrating because I don't know how long I'll have to do it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To solve it perfectly... .

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Yes, the goddess that Adventurer serves needs to have more power. If that happens, I think it will be resolved naturally.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected... . I will try hard too.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: We all know that Adventurer is always working hard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thank you. Then I'll go back to Eastland. I feel like I'll have something to do soon.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Adventurer, if there is anything I can help you with in the future, please let me know. We at Infinite Corridor will be happy to help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you just for your words.

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Oh, there's something I forgot to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Sir Lena Hiren is waiting for Adventurer at the Silvershield Tavern. They say they brought a royal decree from His Majesty to give to Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute?! The emperor who rules the Sylvaria Empire?

lines.speaker: 제이드
lines.text: Yes, I don't know what's going on, but I think you should still hear the story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on... ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I'll go. Thank you, Jade!

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It’s been a while, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It’s been a while, Lena.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I've been trying to take you to the imperial castle, but it wasn't possible so I had to make you wait. A lot has happened in the empire as well. Sorry.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: His Majesty also said he was sorry about this.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: And to those of you who are not here but are watching this situation, I'm sorry for waiting so long. Now your questions will begin to answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, Lena? Who are you talking to now?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Phew… , His Majesty told me to say this to somewhere when I see you. There was nothing I could do because it was Hwang Myeong.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… . Then there is nothing we can do.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Anyway, I heard that you are active in various fields. I heard that the girl he wanted so much to find became a goddess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, several things happened.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: And he became a hero not only in the Mirgandia region but also in distant Eastland... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's amazing. After all, there is a reason why His Majesty is looking at you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not to that extent, though... . By the way, I came because I was told that I would deliver a royal decree from Her Majesty the Empress of the Empire.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: I guess I heard it from the wizard of the Infinite Corridor. But what should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Your Majesty clearly told you to deliver it to %s, but today is not the day.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Speaking of that day... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: You may know this, but Your Majesty has the ability to foresee. Everyone knows this, but we can't keep it a secret.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: His Majesty's foresight was able to prevent something major and dangerous for the continent. You may not know this, but you've already solved some big, dangerous problems.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think you're truly an amazing person to have that kind of ability.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: He really is an amazing person.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The edict will be properly delivered in a few days, so why not rest here in the meantime? The expenses will be paid by Silver Claws.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: The beer here is the best. I've tried every beer in the capital, but I've never found a place as good as this one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go to Tartarus. If you're not there, you don't know what's going to happen.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Ah, that's resolved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? How?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: His Majesty said he received permission to send some interesting items to Tartarus. And he said that since this matter is related to the goddess, he will definitely take charge of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? Am I worse than an interesting object? .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: What do you think? And it seems like Luman thinks you can stay here for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what does this have to do with Iris? Should I just wait?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: It's His Majesty's order, so just wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know now, so I'll wait. It's something I have to do anyway... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Okay. Then come to me again on this exact day. At that time, I will deliver His Majesty’s edict. Hmm, I guess there was something else to talk about... .

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Come by any time before then. If something comes to mind then, I'll let you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, Lena. But you're not just going to rest here and drink beer all the time, right?

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: How did you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, you seem like such a drinker… . Then, finish what you were drinking. I'm going to take a rest now too. See you later.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Okay, get some rest.

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: (I don’t know what your Majesty is thinking, but I’m a little excited.)

lines.speaker: 레나
lines.text: Ah, the glass is empty. Hey, Sarah. A glass of ale, please.
